subject: Hybrid Exec Workshop — gatekeeper schedule, timezone gaps & travel staggering
messages:
From: Emma Shaw <emma.shaw@novushealth.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Novus Health Programs <workshops@novushealth.com>
Date: Sun, 4 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Workshop scheduling: week of Oct 17

Hi Sofia —

Thanks again for walking us through the agenda outline. We are excited to get the Exec Workshop locked in. High-level ask: we need a 3-day onsite (Oct 18–20) in Amsterdam with two hybrid prep half-days (Oct 17 morning + Oct 21 morning) to accommodate remote stakeholders in APAC and US. Core constraints:

- Novus execs available only 10:00–14:00 CET each day (tight window).
- We have a group of US-based engineers joining remotely (they can be present at 09:00–12:00 ET).
- There will be three customer demos that require a 60–90 minute run-through each on-site AV.

Are you able to propose a gatekeeper schedule that staggers arrivals (to reduce single-day airport congestion) and reserves rehearsal windows for the demo teams? Attached: site-plan-v1.pdf (venue layout + room capacities).

Also share any travel support or hotel room blocks Redwood will provide so we can coordinate expense approvals on our side.

Thanks — look forward to the proposed windows.

—Emma
Emma Shaw
Program Manager, Strategic Partnerships
Novus Health


From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Shaw <emma.shaw@novushealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 4 Oct 2026 13:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Workshop scheduling: week of Oct 17

Thanks Emma — this is very helpful. Attached is a first-pass proposed_schedule_v1.xlsx that maps the gatekeeper windows, rehearsal blocks, and a travel-stagger suggestion (arrivals split across Oct 17 evening and Oct 18 early morning). High level:

- Exec windows (10:00–14:00 CET) become our daily customer-facing block. We'll run deep-dive breakout sessions 14:30–17:00 CET for EU on-site participants.
- Rehearsals: three dedicated 90-minute blocks on Oct 17 (11:00 CET / 13:00 CET / 15:00 CET) inside Room A with venue AV reserved.
- Travel staggering: recommend 40% of attendees arrive Oct 17 evening, 60% by 06:00–10:00 CET on Oct 18 to avoid single congestion at Schiphol. Ben—can you confirm ground transport capacity and provide ride manifests?
- AV/IT check: Dylan—please confirm our AV rider and whether we need to ship dongles or if the venue provides HDMI + USB-C.

A few operational notes:
- We should reserve a 30-minute dry-run prior to the first exec session each morning for pre-brief and rapid remediation.
- If any EU-based execs request different times, we can run a 45-minute async briefing recorded at 09:00 CET.

I will open calendar holds for the agreed windows once we confirm transport and AV.

Best,
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Customer Solutions Manager
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: proposed_schedule_v1.xlsx]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 08:17:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Workshop scheduling: week of Oct 17

Sofia — looks good. Two quick additions from CS ops:

- Add a 30-minute buffer after each demo run-through in case of infra flakiness (we've had token-server swap issues in past on day 1).
- For the exec briefing, can we hold 09:30–10:00 CET as a private prep room (exec-only) each day? That will let senior folks sync before the external-facing window.

I'll mark these in the schedule and coordinate with venue to lock the prep room.

Marissa
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 11:42:00 +0000

All — travel/stagger plan attached (arrival_manifest.csv). Quick notes:

- We recommend two pickup windows on Oct 17: 18:00–20:00 (shuttle A) and Oct 18: 06:00–09:30 (shuttle B). Shuttle capacity covers ~60 pax per window.
- For team leads flying from US (3 pax): advise earliest arrival Oct 17 evening to get a full night before day 1.
- Hotel room block confirmed at Hotel Noord (15 rooms) — booking code REDWOOD-NOVUS. I will circulate individual itineraries once flights are final.

Attaching the arrival_manifest.csv and the venue-AV-rider.pdf that Dylan requested to validate connectors.

—Ben

- Novus accepts the rehearsal windows on Oct 17 (11:00 / 13:00 / 15:00 CET) and the private exec prep at 09:30–10:00 CET.
